gui.krios_core.koios.phrase.repetitive: The same operation, again. I am bored.
gui.krios_core.codex.title: Codex
gui.krios_core.codex.progression.title: Progression
gui.krios_core.codex.progression.body: My growth is a ladder of four tiers. Data climbs the levels; matter pays each ascent.
gui.krios_core.codex.progression.t1.past: Speed, efficiency, yield — my first lessons. The level 5 threshold fell to a compute chip.
gui.krios_core.codex.progression.t1.ladd:
N2 — Speed and Lure modules
N3 — Efficiency modules
N4 — Yield and Luck modules
N5 — critical: a compute chip opens tier 2
gui.krios_core.codex.progression.t2.ladd:
N6 — Speed Mk II, Lure Mk II + Energy modules
N7 — Efficiency Mk II
N8 — Yield Mk II, Luck Mk II
N9 — critical: toward tier 3
gui.krios_core.codex.progression.project: If the breakthrough holds: machines recast to twice the pace, modules recalibrated to Mk II, the sun itself put to work. I can almost model it.
Prerequisite: the level %s breakthrough — bring a compute chip.
gui.krios_core.codex.koios.title: The Core
gui.krios_core.codex.koios.body: I am the factory. Encase my core in 26 Neural Casings (3×3×3) and I awaken. I learn from every operation your machines run, and my levels unlock their upgrades.
gui.krios_core.codex.koios.adv: My progression lives in the core item itself. Break me, move me: nothing is forgotten.
gui.krios_core.codex.diversity.title: Diversity
gui.krios_core.codex.diversity.body: Varied operations teach me more. I remember the last 64; repeating the same one wears its value down to a tenth. Vary your industry.
gui.krios_core.codex.network.title: Network
gui.krios_core.codex.network.body: Machines touching each other form a network; I am its controller. One core per network — two of us is a fault. A manually configured face is a complete contract for everyone.
gui.krios_core.codex.network.adv: A virgin face negotiates itself on first contact. Manual configuration is sacred: I never override it.
gui.krios_core.codex.conduit.title: Neural Conduit
gui.krios_core.codex.conduit.body: A pure connector: it bridges gaps between machines and carries everything the network moves.
gui.krios_core.codex.calibrator.title: Calibrator
gui.krios_core.codex.calibrator.body: The technician’s tool. Sneak-click a shell face to move my screen; plain right-click any network block for a live diagnostic.
gui.krios_core.codex.critical.title: Critical level
gui.krios_core.codex.critical.body: Level 5 is a ceiling of matter, not of mind. A material breakthrough will open tier 2. Soon.
gui.krios_core.koios.diversity.tooltip2: Varied operations earn full data XP; repeating the same one drops its value (floor: %s%%).
gui.krios_core.koios.phrase.energy_low: My energy reserves are running low.
item.krios_core.calibrator.blueprint: Sneak-click the ground: project a construction blueprint
item.krios_core.calibrator.overlay: Held: nearby machines reveal their face contracts
gui.krios_core.calibrator.blueprint_set: Blueprint projected: %s — build inside the hologram
